title: Cantrefs and commotes of Wales as listed c. 1570 (Peniarth MS 147; WATU) — Welsh historic boundaries (ArcGIS, 2025)
describe: The medieval Welsh territorial units — cantrefs and their commotes — with boundaries vectorised from the historic sources, shown at the date of the list they come from (Peniarth MS 147, c. 1570); the units are older, but no earlier date is claimed.
